GenerateParams.title: GenerateParams
GenerateParams.description: Every meaningful Stable Audio 3 sampling parameter. ``None`` = model default.

source.title: Source
source.description: Item id (lib:/hist:) or absolute audio path

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: audio2audio: how far from the source (init noise level). inpaint/extend/loop: <1 keeps the source's structure inside the region too

duration_from_source.title: Duration From Source
duration_from_source.description: audio2audio: use the source length as duration

preserve_outside.title: Preserve Outside
preserve_outside.description: inpaint/extend/loop: composite the untouched source back outside the regions

ShiftParams.title: ShiftParams
ShiftParams.description: Inference-time timestep schedule shift. ``default`` uses the model's own.
